pictures.author: Celest
pictures.inspected: Bank context: roofless brown wattle privacy enclosure raised on timber piles over the pond, exposed top/bottom stake lattice, bank path to left and water directly under/in the enclosure. Exact interior and hidden gangway extent obscured.

pictures.author: A.Savin, Wikipedia
pictures.inspected: Close pond-facing oblique: coarse horizontal woven twigs, thin vertical stakes, heavy timber corner piles, lower and upper open lattice, open top, diagonal base brace and narrow plank bank gangway into the short end. No gabled roof or full opaque central floor is visible; hidden inner circulation and pool depth reconstructed.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete roofless wattle bathing enclosure on timber piles: four privacy screens with exposed upper/lower stakes, real shore-side short-end doorway and open timber leaf, narrow inner perimeter deck, flat bank landing, seven supported approach steps, braces and bathing ladder. Original pond remains visible through the genuinely open center and roof. Reuse shared thatch and wood_plain graphs with original geometry, no copied photo pixels. Body size, facing, concealed interior, underwater pile depth and reconstructed approach remain approximate.
